title: The Clock Wound Backward
youtube_title: The Clock Wound Backward | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Honest words let a friend help with the repair.
summary: At a library table by the round window, Kavi is tangled up with a clock wound the wrong way and almost hides it. Kavi tells Miss Dalca the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
